title: Babylonian King List of the Hellenistic Period (BM 35603) — Livius.org, Seleucus IV entries

verification_log.method: Year 125, Simanu 25: Antiochus III "killed in Elam"; Seleucus IV ascends, reigns 12 years; year 137, Ululu 10: Seleucus IV died; same month Antiochus IV ascends (11 years); year 148 Kislimu: death of Antiochus IV heard
